title: IEEE S&P paper wins the Best Social Impact Award at CSAW 2026
summary: Our IEEE S&P 2026 paper, “Usable Anonymity in Reproductive Health Privacy,” received the Best Social Impact Award at the 2026 CSAW Applied Research Competition, hosted by NYU’s Center for Cybersecurity. The competition recognizes published security and privacy research for its technical and social impact. This year, ten finalist papers were selected from 125 submissions, and Qiurong Song presented the work as a poster to a panel of industry and academic judges at the finals in Brooklyn. Congratulations to Qiurong, Lindy, and their collaborators!
details: Usable Anonymity in Reproductive Health Privacy — Qiurong Song, Yanlai Wu, Rie Helene (Lindy) Hernandez, Yao Li, Yubo Kou, and Xinning Gui
